answer_sql:
SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT order_key) AS how_many_orders
FROM contoso_served.v_contoso5_sales_line
WHERE
  currency_code = 'EUR'
  AND order_date BETWEEN CAST('2024-01-01' AS DATE) AND CAST('2024-03-31' AS DATE)
